title: Monitoring Desk Schedule — Alarm Monitoring Entitlements of the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Monitoring Desk Schedule — Alarm Monitoring Entitlements of the Building Automation Service Plans

The monitoring desk works from the following schedule of the Building Automation Service Plans. It states, tier by tier, whether the desk watches the site's alarms, the hours during which it watches them, the target to acknowledge a monitored critical alarm, the monitored alarm responses included per plan year, the fee for each response beyond that allowance, whether an after-hours call-out on a critical alarm is included, and whether tuning to suppress nuisance alarms is included.

| Tier | Alarm monitoring | Monitoring hours | Acknowledgement target (elapsed minutes) | Responses included per plan year | Response overage fee (USD) | Critical alarm call-out after hours | Nuisance alarm tuning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | not included | business hours | 480 | 0 | 165 | not included | not included |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | included | around the clock | 60 | 24 | 145 | not included | included |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | included | around the clock | 45 | 48 | 135 | not included | included |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | included | around the clock | 30 | 72 | 125 | included | included |
| Remote Optimization Plan | included | around the clock | 20 | 150 | 110 | included | included |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | included | around the clock | 10 | 500 | 95 | included | included |

Points for the desk:

- The Controls Help Desk Subscription includes no alarm monitoring; its schedule values for monitoring hours, acknowledgement target and response overage fee are carried in the table for completeness of the tier record and describe no watched site.
- The acknowledgement target is expressed in elapsed minutes. Read across the five monitored tiers it shortens from 60 minutes under the Alarm Monitoring Plan to 10 minutes under the Integrated Building Automation Partnership.
- The after-hours call-out on a critical alarm is included only from the Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan upward.
